faqs.a: Four core services: AI-Driven Marketing built on your live inventory, Content Restructuring for AIO so buyers and AI understand your pages, Custom Workflows & Integrations that connect your DMS, CRM and systems, and a free AI Presence Score that shows how AI search sees your dealership.

Dealership advertising built around live inventory and measurable performance — Google Ads, Meta remarketing and landing pages tied to real units, so spend follows what's actually on your lot and every campaign is traceable to results.

faqs.q: What is Content Restructuring for AIO?
faqs.a: It takes weak, outdated or thin dealership content and rebuilds it so it performs across traditional search, AI answer engines and customer-facing pages — the same structure that helps AI cite and recommend your dealership.

faqs.q: Can Buzznerd connect to my DMS and CRM?
faqs.a: Yes. We build custom workflows and integrations that connect websites, inventory providers, CRM, DMS, ecommerce and marketing platforms — working with Karmak and CDK plus custom DMS and ERP integrations.

faqs.q: How much does an AI Presence Score cost?
faqs.a: It's free. The AI Presence Score scans your dealership and shows how you rank across AEO, AIO, SEO and GEO in about 30 seconds, then emails you the full report.

faqs.q: Do I need a Buzznerd website to use these services?
faqs.a: No. Buzznerd services can work on your existing site and systems. They run best alongside a Buzznerd AI Website and the AI Platform, but marketing, content, integrations and the AI Presence Score can all start independently.
